QRCS third-party components (bundled locally, no CDN required)

jsQR 1.4.0
https://github.com/cozmo/jsQR
Copyright the jsQR contributors.
License: Apache-2.0, included in jsQR-LICENSE.txt.

zxing-wasm 3.1.6 (reader IIFE and WebAssembly)
https://github.com/Sec-ant/zxing-wasm
Copyright (c) 2023 Ze-Zheng Wu.
JavaScript wrapper license: MIT, included in zxing-wasm-LICENSE.txt.

The WebAssembly reader is built from ZXing-C++:
https://github.com/zxing-cpp/zxing-cpp
Copyright the ZXing-C++ and original ZXing contributors.
License: Apache-2.0, included in zxing-cpp-LICENSE.txt.

The distributed upstream decoder assets are unmodified. QRCS supplies local
WASM bytes during initialization and merges validated QR Code results.
